response.overview: DISRUPTION is a psychological thriller created with and alongside disabled filmmakers and performers. Rather than portraying disability as something to overcome, the film challenges society's obsession with "fixing" disability, asking audiences who truly benefits from the idea of being "normal." Developed through workshops with people with disabilities in Singapore, the film combines authentic lived experience with suspense, cinematic storytelling and social commentary. DISRUPTION will be screened with two other films: ASHES & SIGHS, and TEMPLE CRIMES.
response.title: Disruption
